5: import numpy as np

8: def filter_api_calls(
9:     logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
10:     logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
11:     logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
12:     tau_filter: float,
13: ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
14:     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
15:     # Validation
16:     for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
17:         if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
18:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
19:         if arr.ndim != 2:
20:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a two-dimensional matrix")
21:         if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
22:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
23:         if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
24:             raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
25:         if not np.all(arr <= 0):
26:             raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
27:     if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
28:         raise ValueError("all input matrices must have the same shape")
29:     if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
30:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
31:     if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
32:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
33:     if tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
34:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative and finite")
35:     
36:     # Compute sum over future horizon
37:     sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
38:     sum_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
39:     sum_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
40:     
41:     # Best logp from with_result or call_only
42:     best = np.maximum(sum_with, sum_call)
43:     
44:     # Margin of improvement in loss (higher is better)
45:     margin = best - sum_no
46:     keep = margin >= tau_filter
47:     
48:     return (keep, margin)
